verdict.rationale: Bento documents a bulk subscriber endpoint that creates or updates 1–1000 subscribers per request without triggering automations, plus CSV import through its CLI. Its Skills package gives AI agents explicit guidance for bulk subscriber imports. Broadcasts can also target whole segments in one action. Missing for 10: documented bulk operations beyond subscriber create/update/import (e.g., batch events, bulk tagging or deletion), confirmation that the MCP server itself supports batch actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
